original_ai_output.title_zh: 埃多州拆除与疑似邪教及仪式犯罪相关的建筑
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚埃多州政府周三在乌罗米和埃瓦托拆除多栋据称用于仪式活动和邪教犯罪的建筑，此前已逮捕两名嫌疑人。行动由埃多州特别安全小队、警方及其他安全机构联合执行。当局指控嫌疑人埃巴塔·埃罗莫塞莱涉及袭击三名年轻女性，其中一人据报死亡。目前信息仅来自单一来源。

location.raw_text: Uwalor-Oke in Uromi, Esan Central Senatorial District; Ewatto

key_facts.fact: 埃多州政府拆除据称用于仪式活动和邪教犯罪的建筑
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Edo State Government has demolished buildings allegedly used for ritual activities and cult-related crimes following the arrest of two suspects

key_facts.fact: 行动由埃多州特别安全小队、警方及其他安全机构联合执行
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The operation, carried out on Wednesday, involved the Edo State Special Security Squad, the police and other security agencies.

key_facts.fact: 乌罗米Uwalor-Oke的一栋平房和四间佣人房被拆除，据称与疑似仪式犯罪者埃巴塔·埃罗莫塞莱有关
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The government demolished a bungalow and four boys’ quarters at Uwalor-Oke in Uromi, Esan Central Senatorial District, allegedly used by a suspected ritualist, Ebhata Eromosele.

key_facts.fact: 埃瓦托另一栋与邪教活动有关的建筑也被拆除
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Another building linked to cult-related activities in Ewatto was also pulled down.

key_facts.fact: 当局指控埃罗莫塞莱袭击三名年轻女性，其中一人据报死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The authorities alleged that Eromosele was involved in attacks on three young women, one of whom reportedly died.

uncertainties: 嫌疑人涉案情况为当局指控，尚未经司法证实
一名女性死亡为据报，尚未确认
目前仅单一来源报道，缺乏交叉验证
